# Jamf Provider

Manages Jamf Pro resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

terraform {
  required_providers {
    jamfpro = {
      source = "deploymenttheory/jamfpro"
    }
  }
}

provider "jamfpro" {
  # Credentials are read from the environment when not set here.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_group_id` (String) Scopes every request to an account group, sent as the `aid` query parameter. When unset, the API uses the token owner's default account group, which means an object can appear absent rather than merely invisible. May also be set with the `JAMFPRO_ACCOUNT_GROUP_ID` environment variable.
- `api_endpoint` (String) Overrides the API base URL. Defaults to the endpoint the SDK was generated against. May also be set with the `JAMFPRO_API_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `client_id` (String) The OAuth 2.0 client identifier the provider presents to the Jamf Pro token endpoint. May also be set with the `JAMFPRO_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret paired with `client_id`. May also be set with the `JAMFPRO_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.

The provider runs the client-credentials grant itself and holds the resulting access token in memory only, so no token is ever written to configuration or to state.
